title: Law to require lighting under elevated train lines
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to assess streets and sidewalks under elevated train lines run by the MTA or NYC Transit for adequate lighting, and publish the results within one year. Where lighting is found lacking, DOT would have to install distinctive lighting fixtures within three years, subject to funding and approvals. Starting April 1, 2030, DOT would issue annual reports on completed installations for 10 years.
